name: codex-chat-local-tools
description: Workspace-scoped local coding tools with progressive Codex instruction and skill sync.

interface.shortDescription: Local coding tools plus on-demand Codex context sync.
interface.longDescription: A tool-only MCP plugin that gives Codex ChatGPT mode access to explicitly configured local workspaces and progressively loads local Codex-visible AGENTS guidance and skills without browser automation or response scraping.
defaultPrompt: Help me inspect and modify code in one of my configured local workspaces.
